settings.heading: Bayou Blanks vs BlankStyle
settings.answer: Bayou Blanks is the lower-cost blank supplier next to BlankStyle. BlankStyle is a full-service shop — 120+ brands plus in-house printing — with cart bulk discounts that scale with quantity. Bayou skips the extras and passes on liquidation overstock at a flat $1 a unit, the same price on a 4XL as a small.

settings.text: BlankStyle resells first-quality goods from 120+ brands with cart bulk discounts that scale with quantity; Bayou's flat per-unit price needs no volume to unlock.
Bayou is a flat $1/unit from a single pack, with no tiers to chase.
Same price on every size at Bayou: a 4XL is the same $1/unit as a small, while the brands BlankStyle carries upcharge for 2XL and up.
BlankStyle also decorates — screen print, embroidery, DTG — while Bayou supplies blanks only, which is part of why the blank itself costs less.
Both sell with no minimum, no account, and free shipping (around $69+) — the real difference is the price model and the goods.
Where BlankStyle wins: a 120-brand catalog, 30+ warehouses, and one-stop printing. Where Bayou wins: the lowest per-unit on solid blanks, especially extended and plus sizes.

settings.question: Is Bayou Blanks cheaper than BlankStyle?
settings.answer: For the blank itself on small and mid-size orders, yes. BlankStyle's bulk discounts apply in the cart and scale with quantity, so the lowest price needs volume. Bayou is a flat $1 a unit, the same in every size and pack, with no tier to reach. On very large brand orders, BlankStyle's catalog and volume pricing can close the gap.

settings.question: Does BlankStyle have a minimum or require an account?
settings.answer: No and no — BlankStyle sells at wholesale with no minimum and no account or resale license. Bayou is the same. The difference isn't access, it's the price model and the product: BlankStyle resells first-quality brand goods; Bayou passes on liquidation overstock by the pack.

settings.question: Does BlankStyle print shirts, and does Bayou?
settings.answer: BlankStyle offers in-house decoration — screen printing, embroidery, and DTG — so it can be a one-stop shop. Bayou supplies blanks only; you print them yourself or hand them to your decorator. That focus is part of why Bayou's blank price is lower.

settings.question: Does Bayou cost more for plus sizes like 2XL–5XL?
settings.answer: No. Bayou prices every size the same — a 4XL is the same $1/unit as a small. The brand blanks BlankStyle carries add a size upcharge starting at 2XL, so extended sizes is where Bayou's gap is widest.

settings.question: What's the catch with Bayou's liquidation blanks?
settings.answer: Selection. Bayou stocks around 85 curated overstock styles, not a 120-brand catalog. If you need a specific brand and color, BlankStyle's range is far deeper; if you want the lowest per-unit on solid blanks, Bayou wins.

settings.question: BlankStyle or Bayou — which should I use?
settings.answer: Use BlankStyle when you want a specific brand and color, or want one company to print your order too. Use Bayou when per-unit price matters most — especially on small-to-mid orders and extended or plus sizes — and you decorate yourself or just need the blank.
